design_notes: Use hairline rules and two rule weights throughout; serif typeface; single accent colour (e.g., deep blue) for table headers and pull-quote border.
Render the financial table with right-aligned numbers and a clear header row; use a light rule between rows.
Place the pull-quote as a standalone block with a left border in the accent colour, positioned after the paragraph on client concentration.
No decorative imagery or icons; keep the layout clean and newspaper-like.

pull_quotes.after_paragraph: The client list is also a dependency. Western Railway has been a client since 2006 and contributes 52% of the orders on hand
pull_quotes.quote: Western Railway alone accounts for 52% of the orders on hand.
pull_quotes.rationale: Highlights the extreme customer concentration that is a central risk.

sidebars.body_markdown: The company is offering 44,28,000 equity shares of ₹10 each at a price not yet fixed [^drhp-p29]. The issue appears to be entirely fresh shares, with no offer-for-sale line [^drhp-p29]. Proceeds are earmarked for working capital (₹1,130 lakh) and general corporate purposes (amount not disclosed) [^drhp-p48]. No independent appraisal or monitoring agency has been appointed [^drhp-p18]. The lead manager is Mark Corporate Advisors Private Limited and the registrar is Bigshare Services Private Limited [^drhp-p31].
sidebars.rationale: Provides a compact summary of the offer's key terms, complementing the table and reinforcing the fresh-issue nature.
sidebars.title: The offer at a glance
